R1.description: A closed policy key unattended (cleanup, prune, keep_recent min 3, ttl_days 14-3650, prune_max_per_run 1-100) validated strictly: unknown key, wrong type, boolean-as-integer, out of range, duplicate, missing key and the two cross rules refused; an older Manager refuses the file and treats the mode as off

R2.description: The unattended adoption has its own sentence (Adopt the unattended retention policy plus 12 digest characters and a full stop); the record says which kind adopted the digest; an ordinary-only adoption of a file with the key authorises nothing unattended; adopt-retention-policy prints the right sentence and refuses a wrong-kind one, writing nothing

R3.description: status, doctor, adopt preview and retention-cleanup preview print what an unattended adoption authorises and that this release does not enforce it; docs/retention.md documents keys, sentences, fail-safe and status; ROADMAP row 50 added and marked Done; nothing executes unattended
